The '''Mistress of the Hall''' was a position with an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] company. Demanding and complex roles, like that of [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] in ''[[Kallea's Hope]]'', were traditionally reserved for the "Mistress of the Hall" position.
